## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. SPY (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -4.62%) BELOW TREND provide two independent confirmations that risk appetite is elevated.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -4.62%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Stocks vs Bonds supportive: SPY/TLT with SPY (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -0.35%) BELOW TREND → SPY/TLT ↑ rising. Credit watch: Credit Spread (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +0.26%) → flat ABOVE TREND signals mild widening / watch.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Dollar easing: Dollar Strength (1W: -1.40% | 1M: -0.87%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Yield curve flat: Yield Curve (1W: -0.34% | 1M: -0.34%) BELOW TREND → neutral-to-looser financial conditions supporting risk.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +1.69%) ABOVE TREND. Financials/cyclicals showing strength: XLF (sector proxy 1W: +3.90% | 1M: +5.51%) ABOVE TREND while Energy lagging: XLE (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%) CORRECTION. Style: Growth/Momentum leading.

5. US vs Global?
US leadership intact: SPY (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND. EM strong: EEM (1W: +7.02% | 1M: +2.94%) ABOVE TREND while China recovery mixed: FXI (1W: +1.94% | 1M: -0.41%) RECOVERY.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Higher risk tilt: IBIT (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +3.98% | 1M: +3.53%) ABOVE TREND show healthy speculation; ARKK (1W: +1.06% | 1M: -5.17%) RECOVERY signals selective risk-taking.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial reflation evident: CPER (1W: +4.36% | 1M: -0.69%) RECOVERY. Gold taking profits: GLD (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -8.21%) RECOVERY — commodity moves are volatile and showing mixed timeframes.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy under pressure near-term: XLE (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%) CORRECTION, BNO (1W: -12.69% | 1M: +7.29%) CORRECTION, and UNG (1W: -5.11% | 1M: -16.38%) BELOW TREND — watch for continued dispersion in oil/gas.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Broad equity internals — SPY (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +1.69%) ABOVE TREND. MINOR divergence: commodities/energy (USO, BNO, XLE) show 1W weakness vs 1M gains — monitor but not regime-changing.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor growth/cyclicals exposure: XLK (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +1.69%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +13.84% | 1M: +13.08%) ABOVE TREND, EEM (1W: +7.02% | 1M: +2.94%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to energy/commodity beta: XLE (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%) CORRECTION and UNG (1W: -5.11% | 1M: -16.38%) BELOW TREND. Bonds neutral: TLT (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -0.35%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Semis/Tech — SOXX (1W: +13.84% | 1M: +13.08%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +1.69%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy — XLE (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -12.69% | 1M: +7.29%) CORRECTION.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Copper reflation signaled via CPER (1W: +4.36% | 1M: -0.69%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: Natural gas weakness in UNG (1W: -5.11% | 1M: -16.38%) BELOW TREND and oil volatility in USO (1W: -9.50% | 1M: +15.52%) CORRECTION.

13. Key Levels?
VIX/VXX complacency test: VIX Level 30.77 with VXX (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -4.62%) BELOW TREND. Credit health: Credit Spread (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +0.26%) → flat ABOVE TREND. Growth vs Value pivot: Tech/Fin ratio XLK/XLF (1W: +2.44% | 1M: -0.87%) RECOVERY.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive confirming broad strength. Tech and semiconductors showing strength (XLK, SOXX ABOVE TREND); key risk is commodity/energy divergence (XLE, BNO, USO in CORRECTION) and a mild widening in credit spreads to monitor.
